(111202) Fire DMG #1 L10 = 150% of ATK over 7 hits (1/7 each); Notes: when Numby is in Windfall Bonanza it hits 8 times (10% x7 + 30% on the last), the damage is considered both Skill DMG and Follow-Up ATK DMG, and Numby deals +50% DMG (#2) to the Proof of Debt target. Ultimate Turn a Profit! (111203) #1 L10 = Numby DMG +150%, #2 = CRIT DMG +25%, #3 = advance Numby 50% when allies hit the Proof of Debt enemy, ends after #4 = 2 Numby attacks. Talent Trotter Market!? (111204) Proof of Debt: Numby FUA #1 L10 = 150% of ATK, advance #3 = 50%. fixtures.env: Topaz & Numby E0 solo vs 3 Fire-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Deficit... (111201, Fire) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Difficulty Paying? (111202) is Topaz's damaging Skill; the fixture casts it 4 times.
Turn a Profit! (111203) is Topaz's Ultimate action (buff setup, no direct damage); cast twice.
Topaz's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; never a generic attack action.
Numby is a summon with its own timeline slot: it takes 4 separate actions in this fixture.
Numby enters battle as an owned summon (SUMMON_CREATED at battle start).
Difficulty Paying? hits 7 times per cast, or 8 while Numby is in Windfall Bonanza (111202 Notes); the fixture has 2 normal casts (7) and 2 Windfall casts (8) = 30 damage events.
Difficulty Paying? #1 = 150% of ATK at L10 split evenly over 7 hits = 0.21428571428571427 each (111202; the first cast is a normal 7-hit cast).
Difficulty Paying?'s damage is considered both Skill DMG and Follow-Up ATK DMG (111202 Notes): every hit carries the Follow-Up tag and takes FUA-only bonuses (Proof of Debt, E1 Debtor).
While Numby is in Windfall Bonanza (111202 Notes) Difficulty Paying? hits 8 times: 10% x7 + 30% on the final hit, so the greatest per-hit multiplier is 0.45 (30% x 150% ATK at L10).
Numby's FUA (111204) #1 = 150% of ATK at L10 over 7 hits = 0.21428571428571427 each.
Turn a Profit! #1 increases Numby's DMG multiplier by 150% (111203): during Windfall each Numby hit rises to 0.5357142857142857 (x2.5).
Turn a Profit! applies Windfall Bonanza to Numby for #4 = 2 Numby attacks (stored as turns=1 between summon turns).
Turn a Profit! #2 raises Numby's CRIT DMG by 25% while Windfall Bonanza is active.
Deficit... #1 = 100% of ATK at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (canon L10 = 140%; canon L6 = 100%, matching exactly).
Difficulty Paying? marks the target with Proof of Debt (persistent on the most recent target).
Proof of Debt makes Numby deal +50% DMG (#2, L10) to the marked target (111202).
Turn a Profit! #3: while Windfall Bonanza is active, hits on the Proof of Debt enemy advance Numby by 50%; the fixture emits 4 such advances (one per Skill cast window).
Bonus ability: DMG dealt to enemy targets with Fire Weakness +15% applies to Numby.
Bonus ability: the Fire-weak +15% DMG also applies to Topaz's own attacks (canon boosts 'Topaz & Numby's DMG', both units).
The Fire-weak bonus is +15% DMG.
Each Difficulty Paying? costs 1 Skill Point; 4 Skill casts spend 4 SP.
The single Basic ATK restores 1 Skill Point.
Turn a Profit! uses the standard Energy ladder; this rotation regenerates exactly 200 Energy.
Proof of Debt is applied by the first Skill cast before that cast's damage resolves.
